intro: Malaysia is a multicultural country of Malays, Chinese, Indians and many Indigenous peoples.

chapters.title: Many peoples
text: Malays and other Indigenous groups, called Bumiputera ('sons of the soil'), make up about 70% of citizens. About a fifth are of Chinese descent and around 6% of Indian descent. Sabah and Sarawak are home to peoples such as the Iban and Kadazan-Dusun.
Malay is the national language, and English, Chinese dialects and Tamil are widely spoken.

chapters.title: Faith
text: Islam is the official religion and most Malays are Muslim. Buddhism, Christianity and Hinduism are widely practised, and festivals of every faith are public holidays.
